objects.description: During the [2015 Ukraine Electric Power Attack](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0028), [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) used port 443 to communicate with their C2 servers. (Citation: Booz Allen Hamilton)
